reviews.text:
Was my favourite app! But the update on the ‘stats’ section is horrid! Far too much info and numbers, we don’t need to know about touches in the opposition box. 

I much preferred seeing shots and shots on target at the top, but now those stats are in a goal shape, it is far too much info in one place.

reviews.title: Ruined in play football stats at a glance
reviews.text:
Most recent update has completely changed in play football stats for no reason. Changed from clear, coloured bars to a goal and number of shots on/off target. Main viewable stats are now their pre-assigned “top stats”- possession, which is often wrong, big chances, which is subjective, and touches on opposition box, which is irrelevant without displaying clear shots stats. Comparing shots data for 1st and 2nd half now requires scrolling up and down the page to view properly instead of just viewing at a glance at the top. Really disappointing update for something which wasn’t broken. 

TLDR; “top” stats are subjective and not relevant to me. Coloured bars are clearer at a glance compared to a goal with number of shots. Shots stats at the top would be better. 

Either revert back to how it was or make it customisable.
